item.title: Round 2 call for applications is open
item.description:
Round 2 of the Fieldnote accelerator is open for applications until 2026-03-01 23:59:59 Stockholm time.
How we assess. Criteria and weights unchanged from round 1: team 20%, traction 25%, market 20%, product 20%, deeptech 15%. Each criterion is scored 0-100; team counts at most 4 founders. The total is rounded to one decimal, round half up, and applications with a total of 70.0 or more are invited to interview. Founders who took part in an earlier Fieldnote programme receive +3 points.
Currency. Revenue reported by entities in Finland or Estonia is in EUR and is converted at EUR 1 = SEK 11.50 before scoring.
Eligibility. One application per startup per calendar year; withdrawn applications don't count. Applications are assessed as submitted at the deadline.
Apply on the programme page. Questions to programme@fieldnote.example.
